I have found that, in the past, I have tended to stumble on the best sci-fi works or have them recommended by friends. I do not tend to agree with all the 'Top 100 Sci fi novels' lists, so I have decided to list a few novels and writers that I think are excellent and often get overlooked. In no particular order.....

The Expanse Series by James A Corey - A series of rip roaring space opera novels following the adventures of an idealistic captain and his stolen Martian warship as they wage a hopeless war against an ancient Alien threat of unimaginable power. Has been adapted for TV for Syfy and will be premiering in December.

Pandora's Star & Judas Unchained by Peter F Hamilton - A fresh take on the space opera genre, with some truly memorable characters and thrilling action. They also serve as the jumping off point for the generally excellent Commonwealth Saga.

The Greg Mandel Series by Peter F Hamilton - A sci fi detective series featuring a psychic soldier. Again, has Hamilton's excellent mix of great characterisation, intelligent commentary and gripping action.

The Culture Novels by Iain M Banks - Seriously doubt that any Sci-fi fan has missed these, but if so I truly envy them. I would love to experience reading these again for the first time.

The Odyssey by William Shatner - One for trekkies, a series of novels written by the Shat, with help, detailing James T. Kirk's return from the dead to save the galaxy one last time (or three).

Rendezvous with Rama by Arthur C Clarke - Mentioned in my previous thread regarding it's disappointing sequel. The original book, however, is a timeless masterclass in how to write intriguing Sci-fi.

New Frontier by Peter David - Another series for trekkies. I am a huge fan of David, mainly for his creation of Mackenzie Calhoun; a starfleet captain who makes Ben Cisco look like a fluffy little pussy cat. The novels have a good mix of old school TOS exploration and diplomacy as well as some hard-edged, DS9 style moral quandaries.

Anyway, I hope someone finds something on this little list and enjoys it!
